profile.headline: Software Engineer - Observability
profile.summary:
Works on Observability pipelines/instrumentation across Microsoft and open source projects.

Maintainer of OpenTelemetry .NET - https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-dotnet
Maintainer of OpenTelemetry Rust - https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-rust

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Current:
Works on Telemetry Pipelines and Telemetry SDKs at Microsoft.
Maintainer of OpenTelemetry Rust - https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-rust

Previous: Maintainer of OpenTelemetry .NET - https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-dotnet
Worked on SQL Azure - High Availability and Networking
Worked on developing back-end Cloud Services which powers Microsoft Application Insights service.
Worked on Java Agent for Microsoft Application Insights service

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
Developed/Enhanced various web-applications for campus space inventory management.

Redesigned a Classic ASP/VBScript based application to ASP.NET/C# based web-application with completely OO design to achieve performance boost and maintainability.

Automated several repetitive tasks, saving considerable man-hours.

positions.title: Java Developer Intern
positions.description:
Gathered requirements from end-user for an Incident Management/Monitoring tool.

Redeveloped the standalone application written in Java/Swing into a fully evolvable web-based application by using company’s custom frameworks. This involved detailed study and analysis of various applications built using existing frameworks and reusing design principles from them to the new project. (Java/Google Web Toolkit)

positions.title: Lecturer - Dept. of Computer Science
positions.description:
Subjects handled for undergrads- Advanced Software Environments, Computer Security, Network Programming Lab (Java)

Took additional responsibilities of Asst. Placement & Training Officer - coordinated various training sessions in connection with placement.

Took initiative for an ambitious project for the institute, ‘Complete Campus Automation’. Gathered requirements from various stakeholders and held discussions with potential vendors. 

Designed and developed a web-based solution to automate Post-Graduate admissions for the college (ASP.NET-C#, AJAX, MS SQL Server). Took leadership of the project team and was involved in every activity from requirement gathering to deployment/support.

company.name: Viswajyothi College of Engineering and Technology

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
Among Toppers in Infosys Corporate Training with GPA of 5.0/5.0 in Generic Training and Java Stream Training.

Developed various Business Intelligence Reports for a leading apparel retailer (ASP.NET-C#, Crystal Reports, MS-SQL Server, DB2/400). Gathered and documented complex requirements directly from client.

Re-wrote several stored procedures and achieved significant performance enhancement.

Developed a Request for Service (RFS) Tracker application  for a leading apparel retailer (ASP.NET-C#, AJAX, MS-SQL Server)

Selected as member of Self Governance Team (SGT) that primarily acted as a buffer between trainees and senior management.

courses.name: Advanced Software Engineering (focus area - multi core programming)

projects.title: Travel Planner Web Service
projects.description: Developed a Road Trip Planner Web application by mashing up several Google APIs. Based on user preferences, the application generates itineraries for the user, which can be fully customized.

projects.title: Parallelizing XML Parser
projects.description: Redesigned an existing open source XML Parser to run faster on multi-core systems– achieved up to 30% performance boost.
